title: The Medieval Miller
hook: Everyone in the village hated this one man.

scenes.text: In every medieval village, by law, peasants had to grind their harvested grain at the lord's mill.

scenes.text: Because he controlled the scales, peasants constantly suspected millers of cheating and stealing flour.
